name: Eurasia of End
original_name: ユウラシア・オブ・エンド
source:
The youngest of the Netherworld sisters. She's a prodigy when it comes to magic. She's really interested in all the things she enjoys and indifferent towards everything else. Recently she's started wanting a cell phone so much that she can't stand it.

“Feeling like you're having fun is super important!”
